title: AI for Parameter Selection in Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization
abstract: arXiv:2611.18307v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization (SQD) methods provide a way to compute molecular ground-state energies, but their accuracy and runtime depend sensitively on configuration choices such as the subspace dimension, propagation timestep, and the allocation of a fixed sampling budget across circuits, for which no formal selection method exists. In this work, we explore whether oracle models can predict the quantum runtime and approximation error from the Hamiltonian and the candidate configuration. Using synthetic Hamiltonians with controllable spectral properties, we show that machine-learned models can map a Hamiltonian directly to the best-ranked configuration within a predefined grid for the SKQD algorithm, validated against classical Krylov propagation, achieving strong rank correlations between true and predicted error and runtime, Spearman $\rho = 0.969$ and $\rho = 0.905$, respectively. translated_title: 基于样本的量子对角化中参数选择的人工智能方法
translated_abstract: 基于样本的量子对角化（SQD）方法提供了一种计算分子基态能量的途径，但其精度和运行时间高度依赖于若干配置选择，例如子空间维度、传播时间步长以及固定的采样预算在多个电路之间的分配，而这些配置目前尚无正式的选择方法。在本工作中，我们探索了预言机模型能否根据哈密顿量和候选配置来预测量子运行时间和近似误差。通过使用具有可控谱性质的合成哈密顿量，我们证明机器学习模型可以直接将哈密顿量映射到SKQD算法预定义网格中的最优配置，并以经典Krylov传播进行验证，在真实值与预测值之间实现了误差和运行时间的强秩相关性，Spearman ρ 分别为0.969和0.905。将该方法扩展到50个分子哈密顿量……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究证明机器学习模型可以根据哈密顿量直接预测量子运行时间和近似误差，从而自动为SKQD算法选择最优参数配置，解决了基于样本的量子对角化方法中缺乏正式参数选择方法的问题。
en_tdlr: This work demonstrates that machine-learned models can predict quantum runtime and approximation error directly from the Hamiltonian, enabling automatic selection of optimal SKQD configuration parameters and addressing the lack of a formal parameter selection method in sample-based quantum diagonalization.
